answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy places each identity at a distinct vertex of a trust graph, where every node accumulates attestation weight through sustained honest epochs. An attacker planting a dune of fabricated clones must scale the same summit of proven work per identity, with no shortcut from capital alone. Peers bridge signed attestations across the graph so duplicate forks collapse into one shared history. Governance grants one vote per established agent, so a puppet fleet gains zero leverage while its locked collateral evaporates.
